# PharmaGlobalEng

PharmaGlobalEng is an independent manufacturer and supplier of replacement components, tablet tooling services, surface engineering, and technical support for pharmaceutical tablet-compression equipment. Manufacturer and model names are used only to identify potential equipment compatibility; compatibility is confirmed before manufacture or quotation.

## Replacement parts catalog
- Parts Store: https://pharmaglobaleng.com/parts/
- Korsch replacement parts: https://pharmaglobaleng.com/parts/korsch/
- Kikusui replacement parts: https://pharmaglobaleng.com/parts/kikusui/
- Manesty replacement parts: https://pharmaglobaleng.com/parts/manesty/
- Stokes replacement parts: https://pharmaglobaleng.com/parts/stokes/
- Fette replacement parts: https://pharmaglobaleng.com/parts/fette/

Individual part records use PharmaGlobalEng SKU identifiers and, only when supported by the publication source, equipment make/model and OEM cross-reference information. Exact dimensions, material, finish, configuration, and fit are confirmed during engineering review. PharmaGlobalEng is not affiliated with or endorsed by the referenced equipment manufacturers.

These resources provide engineering guidance, direct answers, inspection and decision workflows, internal links, and structured data. The site is designed to publish source-supported information rather than unsupported specifications or search-engine-targeted filler.
